executiveSummary: Recent tech news highlights Apple's focus on AI, hardware releases, and industry shifts, with emerging trends including content deals for Siri, mechanical keyboards, and item tracking networks.

takeaways.title: Apple's Content Deals
takeaways.description: Apple is proposing multiyear agreements to give Siri AI access to current news and information, potentially changing the way publishers distribute their content.

takeaways.title: Mechanical Keyboards
takeaways.description: The 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard with Dual Super Buttons is on sale for $69.99, offering a retro flair at an affordable price.

takeaways.title: Item Tracking Networks
takeaways.description: Google has introduced the Pixel Tag, its answer to Apple's AirTag, which uses an item tracking network to keep satellites at work longer.

worthWatching: Google is developing a new AI-powered robot space mechanic to attach a new thruster to an aging satellite.
Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series phones will launch this fall, with the iPhone 17's successor potentially skipping the fall launch in 2027.
engineeringPerspective: The use of machine learning and computer vision in image recognition has improved for Apple's AirTag competitor, Pixel Tag.
Apple's retail trade-in system is being developed to let customers save a trade-in offer to the Wallet app for up to 90 days.
